thought: Miaou! No enemies, so I explore ze whole salon to find ze red key and ze exit, tout de suite!
Miaou! Ze mice ran away like cowards! I grab ze bullets at (12,3) and keep exploring east to find ze red key, oh là là!
Aïe aïe! 26% health, ze bulldog bit me hard at +131° and a mouse is at 0°! But I see ze RED KEY at (7,22) on ze map, magnifique! Pew pew ze mouse at 0°, then RUN to ze key, miaou!
Aïe aïe aïe! 5% health, sacré bleu! A cheese-throwing mouse right in front at 0°! Pew pew pew NOW, then I RUN-RUN to ze health +10 at (4,1), oh là là my poor chonky belly!
Aïe! A mouse bit my left side at -48°! Hssss! I turn left, pew pew pew, then strafe and keep exploring north for the RED key, miaou!
Oh là là! Ze EXIT switch is at (24,23) on my map, just south of me! But a big brown Bulldog is somewhere — I go straight to ze EXIT and press it, miaou, let's finish ze level!
Miaou! Health 1% - one YAP and I'm kibble! The Chihuahua is at +14° blocking my path to the EXIT! I pew pew pew FAST with my laser pistol, then I RUN straight to the EXIT switch! Go go go, Le Chonk!

Miaou! Level 3, La Cave! Health is très low at 1%, but I have 72% armor - my fluffy belly is protecting me! I see a CHAINGUN at (3,4) and bullets at (2,5). First, let me grab that chaingun - pew pew pew will be magnifique against REX! Then I'll explore for keys. Zut alors, let's go!

Yummy! Tuna! 101% health, RED KEY in my fluffy paws, and 199 bullets! Now I need ze BLUE KEY and to find REX's arena. Let me open ze RED door at (8,10) - it leads somewhere new! Then explore ze north for ze blue key. Miaou, let's go!
